name: FXTrade
description: Aggregate root for a foreign exchange spot trade executed by SVC-007 (Treasury Services, CAP-002.04 promoted) on behalf of a corporate client. Created in PH-059 (Trade Enquiry) with status = enquiry and progresses through the full FX trade lifecycle to settled. Owns the complete audit trail from indicative rate request through to T+2 settlement. Referenced by ENT-041 (FXQuote) and ENT-042 (FXSettlement) via trade_id FK. This entity is foundational for UK MiFIR transaction reporting — all fields required for FCA trade repository submission are captured here. Introduced by JRN-014.
owning_capability: CAP-002 (Commercial Banking — Treasury Services, CAP-002.04 PROMOTED)

fields.name: trade_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable. Globally unique across the bank's treasury trading book.

fields.name: client_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id (ENT-B001, owned by SVC-005). Immutable. SVC-007 holds no local copy of BusinessCustomer data.

fields.name: dealer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Staff.staff_id for PER-053 (Treasury Dealer). Must be a currently FCA-certified dealer under SM&CR. Immutable.

fields.name: buy_currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: buy_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required after PH-061. Positive decimal, max 2 dp. Amount the client will receive in buy_currency. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: sell_currency
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 4217 3-letter currency code. Must differ from buy_currency. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: sell_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 dp. Amount the client will deliver in sell_currency. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: rate
fields.validation_rule: Required after PH-061. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. All-in FX rate inclusive of spread. Populated from FXQuote.firm_rate on acceptance. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: value_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Spot = T+2 business days from dealt_at. Immutable after status = booked.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: enquiry | booked | confirmed | settlement_held | settlement_failed | settled | cancelled.

fields.name: dealt_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when status = booked. Immutable. MiFIR reporting timestamp.

fields.name: confirmation_sent
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default false. Set to true when SWIFT MT300 dispatched (PH-062).

fields.name: call_recording_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. For voice-executed trades only. Reference to COBS 11.2A call recording. Format: CALL-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.

fields.name: mifir_transaction_ref
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. UTI (Unique Transaction Identifier) per ISO 23897. Set after MiFIR report submitted to FCA trade repository. Populated in PH-062.
fields.computed_from: Generated by SVC-007 using ISO 23897 UTI standard on trade booking (PH-061)

fields.name: interbank_reference_rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 6 decimal places. Bloomberg FXGO mid-rate at time of firm quote — best-execution reference benchmark for MiFIR. Immutable.

relationships.description: FXTrade may have multiple FXQuote records (re-quotes on expiry). Only one FXQuote may have status = accepted at any time.
FXTrade has one FXSettlement record created at PH-063.
FXTrade belongs to one BusinessCustomer via client_id FK. BusinessCustomer owned by SVC-005 — SVC-007 holds no local copy.

design_decisions.decision: FXTrade stores interbank_reference_rate as an immutable field alongside the executed rate.
design_decisions.rationale: UK MiFIR best execution obligations require an auditable comparison of the client rate against the interbank benchmark. Storing the Bloomberg mid-rate at quote time co-locates the evidence with the trade record.

design_decisions.decision: FXTrade.rate is denormalised from FXQuote.firm_rate on acceptance.
design_decisions.rationale: Denormalisation avoids a join to ENT-041 on every MiFIR report, confirmation document, or settlement instruction read. FXQuote remains the canonical source; FXTrade.rate is a derived, immutable copy.
